templateStory.scope.en: Each beat can have up to six image links.
templateStory.scope.zh-Hans: 每段剧情最多可填六个图片链接。

templateStory.historicalImages.en: This beat has more than six images. You can keep them or remove some.
templateStory.historicalImages.zh-Hans: 此段落超过六张图片，可保留或删除部分。

templateStory.imageLimit.en: Up to six images per beat. The change wasn't saved.
templateStory.imageLimit.zh-Hans: 每段最多六张图片，本次修改未保存。

templateStory.unsupported.en: This story uses an unsupported or malformed format. Its original content is preserved and cannot be edited here.
templateStory.unsupported.zh-Hans: 此剧情格式不受支持或已损坏。原始内容已保留，无法在此编辑。

templateStory.derivedSummary.en: The summary is made from the beats, up to 500 characters.
templateStory.derivedSummary.zh-Hans: 摘要由各段剧情拼成，最多 500 字。

templateStory.summaryBoundary.en: Adjust the text near the 500-character limit; the summary can't end there.
templateStory.summaryBoundary.zh-Hans: 请调整 500 字附近的文字，摘要无法在此处截断。
